name: SimplyBook.me
description_en:
SimplyBook.me provides a hosted booking website and widgets for service businesses. Services, providers, availability and client records form the core, while selectable custom features add functions such as intake forms, memberships or payment options.

Plan choice depends on three quantities at once: monthly bookings, providers and concurrently enabled premium custom features. A feature appearing in the catalogue is not evidence that it fits the Free allowance or is available during every trial.
description_zh:
SimplyBook.me 为服务业务提供托管预约网站及组件，以服务、提供者、可用性及客户记录为核心，可选自定义功能加入资料表单、会员或付款等能力。

选档需同时看每月预约数、服务提供者数量及同时启用的高级自定义功能数。某能力出现在目录中，不代表符合 Free 额度，也不代表每项试用都可用。

core_features.explanation_en: Associate services with providers, durations, buffers and simultaneous client limits.
core_features.explanation_zh: 关联服务、提供者、时长、缓冲及同时接待人数。

core_features.explanation_en: Premium custom features consume the plan’s active feature allowance; free custom features do not.
core_features.explanation_zh: 高级自定义功能消耗套餐启用额度，免费自定义功能不计入。

core_features.explanation_en: SMS, WhatsApp and AI voice credits are sold separately from the subscription.
core_features.explanation_zh: 短信、WhatsApp 及 AI 语音额度与订阅分开销售。

en: Define a training service, assign providers, set duration and buffer time, and choose the information clients must submit. Publish the booking website or embed the widget. If intake, membership and payment features are all required, count which premium custom features must remain active simultaneously before choosing a tier.
zh: 定义训练服务、指定提供者、设置时长及缓冲，并决定客户提交哪些资料，再发布预约站或嵌入组件。如果同时需要资料表、会员及付款，应在选档前计算哪些高级功能需要同时启用。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative evaluation workflow; no customer adoption or savings measured.

pricing.billing_basis: Flat tiers across bookings/providers/premium custom features, annual/monthly billing; messaging, voice and setup add-ons separate.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Flat tiers across bookings/providers/premium custom features, annual/monthly billing; messaging, voice and setup add-ons separate.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 按预约/提供者/高级自定义功能组合分档，分年付/月付；消息、语音及配置附加项另计。

official_check.scope: Public official documents only; no account, purchase, hands-on test, independent review, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from attached official sources. Product behavior is vendor-documented, not independently tested.
All records remain draft. Chinese prose does not establish a Chinese software interface.

sections.title_en: Example: a trainer who needs an intake form
sections.title_zh: 示例：需要资料表单的教练
sections.en:
Define a training service, assign providers, set duration and buffer time, and choose the information clients must submit. Publish the booking website or embed the widget. If intake, membership and payment features are all required, count which premium custom features must remain active simultaneously before choosing a tier.

Test a full provider slot, a changed booking and a canceled session. Compare the customer notice, provider schedule and payment reference. This is an editorial acceptance scenario, not an account test. A successful booking does not establish correct refunds or medical-record handling.
sections.zh:
定义训练服务、指定提供者、设置时长及缓冲，并决定客户提交哪些资料，再发布预约站或嵌入组件。如果同时需要资料表、会员及付款，应在选档前计算哪些高级功能需要同时启用。

建议测试提供者时段已满、预约变更及取消，对照客户通知、提供者日程与付款引用。这是编辑验收场景，未实际测试账户。预约成功不能证明退款或医疗记录处理正确。

sections.title_zh: 预约、提供者及高级功能槽位
sections.en:
The GBP monthly view lists Free with 50 bookings, one premium custom feature and one provider; Basic at £12.90 with 100/3/5; Standard at £25 with 500/8/15; Premium at £55 with 2,000/unlimited/30. Annual-billing monthly equivalents are separately displayed. “Unlimited custom features” does not mean unlimited bookings or providers.

The FAQ distinguishes free custom features, which do not count, from premium custom features, which do. Free has no time limit but requires monthly renewal. The trial is fourteen days with fifty bookings, and the fine print excludes certain features including HIPAA and POS, despite broader FAQ wording about unlimited features. Treat the detailed exclusions as unresolved trial boundaries to verify in the account.
sections.zh:
英镑月付视图列出：Free 含 50 次预约、一个高级功能及一位提供者；Basic £12.90 含 100/3/5；Standard £25 含 500/8/15；Premium £55 含 2,000/不限/30。年付月均另列。“自定义功能不限”不表示预约或提供者不限。

FAQ 区分不计额度的免费自定义功能和计额度的高级功能。Free 无时间限制，但需每月续期。试用十四天、五十次预约，细则排除 HIPAA 和 POS 等功能，即使 FAQ 另有“功能不限”的概括。应把详细排除项作为需在账户确认的试用边界。

sections.title_en: The plan is only one part of cost
sections.title_zh: 套餐只是成本的一部分
sections.en:
The page separately sells SMS, WhatsApp, AI voice and booking credits, plus domain/setup services. Those add-ons are shown with dollar symbols even where subscription cards use GBP, so do not add mixed currencies into a single budget without checking checkout. Credit quantities are not necessarily delivered-message quantities.

Payments and deposits are listed from Basic, advanced Payments PRO from Premium, and regional/data-location/contract options in Enterprise. Processor fees, messaging rates and actual compliance entitlements need their own check. A branded customer app, full setup service and high-load API should not be assumed included in the base plan.
sections.zh:
页面单独销售短信、WhatsApp、AI 语音及预约额度，以及域名/配置服务。订阅卡片使用 GBP 时，部分附加项仍显示美元符号，未核对结算前不能混合货币做总预算。额度数量也不一定等于实际送达消息数量。

Basic 起列出付款与订金，Premium 起列出高级 Payments PRO，Enterprise 提供地区/数据位置/合同选项。处理费、消息费率及实际合规权益需单查，不能默认基础档包含品牌客户应用、完整配置服务或高负载 API。

sections.title_en: Managed booking, optional AI and failure checks
sections.title_zh: 托管预约、可选 AI 与失败检查
sections.en:
The homepage introduces Ask Simply and MCP/AI voice extensions alongside ordinary scheduling. They extend interaction, not the fundamental need to define services and check availability. The public service may suit appointment businesses wanting a configurable booking site; a developer requiring a self-hosted codebase has no established distribution here.

If a provider slot or message is wrong, inspect service assignment, schedule, active features and credit balance before rebooking. No AI action, API call, payment, calendar synchronization, export or recovery was tested. Software licence and final retention/region obligations remain contract-specific.
sections.zh:
首页将 Ask Simply、MCP/AI 语音扩展与常规排程并列介绍。它们扩展交互，不会替代定义服务和核对可用性的基本工作。希望定制预约站的服务企业可评估使用；需要自托管代码库的开发者，不能从这里推定有发行版。

提供者时段或消息异常时，重新预约前检查服务分配、日程、启用功能及额度。未实际测试 AI 动作、API、付款、日历同步、导出或恢复。软件许可及最终保留/地区义务仍依合同。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: Trial FAQ and fine-print scope differ; Free client-app wording also differs across page blocks. Confirm exact active entitlements.
research_gaps.zh: 试用 FAQ 与细则范围不一致，Free 客户应用措辞在不同区块也有差异，需确认实际启用权益。

research_gaps.en: No account, credits, processor costs, API, licence, data location, regulatory workflow or restoration test was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试账户、额度、处理费、API、许可、数据位置、监管流程或恢复。
